# SmartMart Inventory and Vendor Escalation Policy

## Purpose

This synthetic internal policy defines supporting management guidance
for inventory replenishment, product availability, vendor delivery,
and supplier reliability review at SmartMart Retail Pvt. Ltd.

## Inventory Replenishment and Product Availability

Stores must review inventory replenishment when current stock falls
below the approved reorder requirement or when repeated product
availability problems are detected.

Low stock and stockout risk require investigation of current stock,
reorder requirements, replenishment timing, supplier delivery
performance, and fulfilment reliability.

Where inventory availability remains constrained, the responsible
manager should review the replenishment process before approving a
corrective action.

## Vendor Delivery and Supplier Reliability

Repeated vendor delivery delays require review of supplier reliability,
delivery performance, and fulfilment capacity.

Partial deliveries require investigation of ordered quantity, received
quantity, delivery timing, and supplier capacity.

Where product availability risk coincides with repeated vendor delay,
management should review both inventory replenishment and vendor
delivery performance before selecting a corrective action.

## Procurement Review

Procurement should review repeated supplier delay, partial fulfilment,
and delivery reliability against the applicable vendor performance
expectations.

Operational evidence from the business system remains the factual basis
for determining whether a specific store, product, or vendor is
currently affected.

## Management Approval

This policy provides supporting business context for analysis.
Recommendations remain subject to manager review and approval before
task creation or workflow execution.
